result.instructions: Tools for Just-In, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is on the shift roster for next Tuesday, and which shifts are still open?"; "List the leave requests waiting for approval this month."; "Show each employee's computed hours for last month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Just-In data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run justin_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run justin_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run justin_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. justin_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: justin_get_account
tools.title: Check the API token
tools.description: Confirm the API token works. Returns the company it belongs to, its abilities, expiry, whether an IP allowlist is active, and the client IP as Just-In sees it. No business data. Just-In API: GET /api/v1/me.

tools.name: justin_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees of the company, with department and branch. Supports incremental sync with updated_since. Just-In API: GET /api/v1/employees.

updated_since.description: Only records created or changed at/after this ISO 8601 date or datetime.

sort.description: Field to sort by; prefix with '-' for descending. An unknown field returns 422.

tools.name: justin_get_employee
tools.title: Get an employee
tools.description: Get one employee by Just-In id. Just-In API: GET /api/v1/employees/{id}.

tools.name: justin_list_attendance
tools.title: List attendance records
tools.description: List attendance records (one working day per employee) between two dates, with optional employee, department, branch and status filters. Just-In API: GET /api/v1/attendance.

employee_external_id.description: Employee id in your own system (alternative to employee_id).

status.description: Record status filter, as Just-In defines it.

updated_since.description: Only records created or changed at/after this ISO 8601 date or datetime.

sort.description: Field to sort by; prefix with '-' for descending. An unknown field returns 422.

tools.name: justin_get_attendance_record
tools.title: Get an attendance record
tools.description: Get one attendance record by id. Just-In API: GET /api/v1/attendance/{id}.

tools.name: justin_list_leave_requests
tools.title: List leave requests
tools.description: List leave and absence requests for one month. approval_status: open, signed_by_employee or approved. Just-In API: GET /api/v1/leave.

employee_external_id.description: Employee id in your own system (alternative to employee_id).

tools.name: justin_get_leave_request
tools.title: Get a leave request
tools.description: Get one leave or absence request by id. Just-In API: GET /api/v1/leave/{id}.

tools.name: justin_list_schedule_shifts
tools.title: List scheduled shifts
tools.description: List the shift roster between two dates (default: today to today + 28 days, max 93 days). Includes drafts; check the published flag. Needs the Work Scheduling plan feature. Just-In API: GET /api/v1/schedule/shifts.

employee_id.description: Only shifts assigned to this employee.

employee_external_id.description: Employee id in your own system (alternative to employee_id).

published.description: true = published only, false = drafts only.

open.description: true = open shifts with nobody assigned only.

tools.name: justin_get_schedule_shift
tools.title: Get a scheduled shift
tools.description: Get one scheduled shift by id, with its assignees. Just-In API: GET /api/v1/schedule/shifts/{id}.

tools.name: justin_list_sites
tools.title: List sites
tools.description: List the company's work sites, used for shift locations. Just-In API: GET /api/v1/sites.

tools.name: justin_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List the company's departments. Just-In API: GET /api/v1/departments.

tools.name: justin_list_branches
tools.title: List branches
tools.description: List the company's branches. Just-In API: GET /api/v1/branches.

tools.name: justin_get_timesheets
tools.title: Get monthly timesheets
tools.description: Get computed monthly hours per employee (100%, 125%, 150%, 200%, night shifts), absence days and the report's approval status. No pay amounts. Pull a month once its status is approved. Just-In API: GET /api/v1/timesheets.

tools.name: justin_create_leave_request
tools.title: Create a leave request
tools.description: Create a leave or absence request for an employee. It stays pending for a manager to approve in Just-In; it is never auto-approved by this tool. Needs the leave:write ability. Just-In API: POST /api/v1/leave.

employee_id.description: Employee id. Give this or employee_external_id.

employee_external_id.description: Employee id in your system. Give this or employee_id.

date_to.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD. At most 31 days after date_from.

type.description: Leave type, in Hebrew as Just-In names it: vacation, sick, reserve duty, mourning, pregnancy check, parental hour, unpaid absence.

tools.name: justin_resolve_leave_requests
tools.title: Approve or reject leave requests
tools.description: Approve or reject up to 100 leave requests in one call. Approved leave becomes an absence day in the timesheet. Needs the leave:write ability. Just-In API: POST /api/v1/leave/resolve.

ids.description: Leave request ids to resolve (from justin_list_leave_requests).

tools.name: justin_create_schedule_shift
tools.title: Create a draft shift
tools.description: Create a one-off shift as a draft. Staff do not see a draft until someone publishes it in Just-In; this tool never publishes. Needs the schedule:write ability and the Work Scheduling feature. Just-In API: POST /api/v1/schedule/shifts.

employee_ids.description: Up to 50 employees to assign. Omit for an open shift.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Just-In
prompts.description: What you can do with Just-In here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_the_shift_roster_for_the_coming_weeks
prompts.title: Check the shift roster for the coming weeks
prompts.description: List the shifts between two dates, including drafts, and check the published flag. Open one shift to see its assignees.

prompts.name: review_leave_requests_for_one_month
prompts.title: Review leave requests for one month
prompts.description: List the leave and absence requests of a month, filtered by approval status such as open. Open one request to read its details.

prompts.name: approve_or_reject_a_batch_of_leave_requests
prompts.title: Approve or reject a batch of leave requests
prompts.description: List the open leave requests, then approve or reject up to 100 of them in one call. Approved leave becomes an absence day in the timesheet.

prompts.name: check_computed_monthly_hours_per_employee
prompts.title: Check computed monthly hours per employee
prompts.description: Get the computed hours of each employee for one month: 100%, 125%, 150%, 200% and night shifts. Pull a month once its report is approved.

prompts.name: review_attendance_for_one_department
prompts.title: Review attendance for one department
prompts.description: List attendance records between two dates, filtered by department, branch or status. Open one record to see its details.

prompts.name: draft_an_evening_shift_at_a_site
prompts.title: Draft an evening shift at a site
prompts.description: Find the site and the employees, then create a one-off shift as a draft. Staff do not see the draft until someone publishes it in Just-In.
